positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
At Perficient, I support the development and validation of advanced cancer screening software for a leading biotech client. My role spans backend and UI test automation, system analysis, and documentation within a highly regulated environment.

I collaborate with cross-functional and offshore teams to design scalable test automation frameworks using tools like Python, Pytest, and Selenium. I’ve streamlined test execution by building custom scripts that dramatically reduce setup time, and introduced automation for QA documentation that eliminates repetitive manual work.

To better understand and communicate system behavior, I created a data analysis tool using the Dash framework, enabling more informed decision-making across the team. I also help ensure that compliance and release documentation is routed efficiently, supporting timely software delivery.

My focus has been on improving reliability, performance, and productivity across the software development lifecycle while working in an Agile environment that demands adaptability and collaboration.
